title: Neo-Hookean hyperelastic model
objective: Add a neo-Hookean constitutive model with strain energy Psi = (mu/2)(I1_bar - 3) + (kappa/2)(J - 1)^2, following the same interface (pk2_stress, material_tangent) used by SVK.
scope: Derive the PK2 stress and material tangent by differentiating Psi analytically (isochoric-volumetric split).
Match the SVK module shape so the codegen dispatch table can add it with one entry.
implementation_steps: Read `svk.py` to pick up the module shape.
Derive S_IJ = 2 dPsi/dC analytically using the invariant decomposition.
Unit-test: at F = I, S = 0. Under pure dilation F = lambda I, check volumetric response matches hand calc.
acceptance_criteria: At F = I, S = 0 and C matches the linear elastic 4th-order tangent (with mu, kappa).
Pure dilation test: S is hydrostatic and matches hand calc.
AD oracle (deferred to P4-5) will verify the full derivative chain.

cases: Simple shear stress matches hand calc

risks: The isochoric-volumetric split has several equivalent forms (modified Cauchy-Green, etc.). Mitigation: pick one form and document it in the module docstring.
completion_notes: Closed-form PK2 + 4th-order tangent derived by hand from Psi = (mu/2)(I1_bar - 3) + (kappa/2)(J - 1)^2
NeoHookeanMaterial dataclass with from_E_nu constructor + NeoHookeanModel ABC wrapper
